description:
Supply-chain links between Taiwan-listed companies and US-listed companies, found in US annual reports (SEC
    10-K / 20-F) and reviewed by the editor: who supplies whom, competitors, partners, each with the quoted sentence
    and the filing. Give a Taiwan company (code or name) or a US company name (e.g. 'NVIDIA', 'Apple').
    relation: supplier, competitor or partner. Read each link as: a_name <relation> b_name (a is supplier of b).
name: get_supply_chain
title: Supply chain (US filings)
